Package com.hkust.marketplace.forms

Class ListingFormState

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.forms.ListingFormState
public class ListingFormState extends Object
Pure-Java state behind the create-listing form.

No JavaFX types live here: the file chooser and controls belong to the view, so this class can be unit-tested without a toolkit. All common fields are plain values, which means switching the listing type can never discard what the user already typed. The three concrete listing kinds are disjoint subclasses (ADR-0004), so a value entered for one type cannot leak into another type's saved object.

    • canAddMorePhotos

      public boolean canAddMorePhotos()
      Whether another photo can be added (at most six overall).

      Photos already saved with the listing count toward the cap too, so an edit form can never hold more than MAX_PHOTOS photos between its stored and newly chosen ones.

    • loadFrom

      public void loadFrom(Listing listing)
      Loads an existing listing into this state so the edit form can start prefilled.

      The stored photo paths are copied for display, and the type-specific raw values are taken from the concrete subclass. Values belonging to the other kinds are cleared first, so a reused state can never leak a stale price or duration into the edited listing.

      Parameters:
      listing - the listing being edited

    • validate

      public Map<String,String> validate(Seller seller)
